text: Capability: formal partner/distributor GTM layer is publicly documented.
Evidence boundary: the sources establish what Ultimate Solutions says its program provides; they do not establish actual commercial impact.
Benchmark implication: treat this as a documented ONYX-ecosystem capability and keep the YemenSoft ownership/operational linkage as an open research question.
